responses: Poornasree Equipments Pvt Ltd manufactures and supports milk analyzer equipment and related products such as LactoSure and LactoGrand analyzers, Vibro ultrasonic stirrers, adapters, and data/display accessories. We provide WhatsApp-based troubleshooting and field service support across India. For live help, contact Customer Care at +91 94009 61291.

Our main product lines include: LactoSure ECO series (ECO V3, ECO S, ECO V, ECO SV, ECO D), LactoGrand series (Lite, S Pro, S Pro Connect +, SD), Vibro Ultrasonic Stirrer, LactoSure EXD (external display), and LactoSure DPS-T (data processing system). For model-specific troubleshooting, tell me your machine name and the problem you are facing.

You can reach Poornasree Customer Care on WhatsApp/phone at +91 94009 61291. You can also ask me to connect you to a live support agent from this chat, or ask me to help raise a service visit request.
I can help you raise a service request. Tell me your machine model and the issue, or tap Book service visit. Our team will arrange field support after we collect the needed details.
